chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 309: The Poisoned Betrayer
chapter_meta_description: Han Li’s failsafe kills the traitorous Fifth Sister just as she dreams of Foundation Establishment. A night raid on the Xin Prince’s Mansion hits a snag when the Young Prince is nowhere to be found.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 309
og_description: Han Li’s dormant poison activates, and the raid on the Young Prince’s mansion finds only an illusion. A chapter of cold, silent victory.
twitter_description: The Fifth Sister’s reward turns to ash. Han Li’s night raid comes up empty. The game of cold calculation continues.

lore_anchors.definition: A dual-purpose medicine: acts as a life-saving antidote, but can be transformed into a lethal poison through a specific activation technique, reflecting a philosophy of controlled utility.
A dark ritual placed on a subordinate’s body that allows a master to inflict lethal punishment or trigger a pre-determined death remotely; it is an institutional leash in the cultivation world.
A method of magically dominating a weaker person’s mind to extract information or force obedience.
The second major stage of cultivation, representing a massive leap in power and lifespan; often the unattainable dream for most Qi Condensation cultivators, leading them to make desperate bargains.
A type of spell used to create illusions, decoys, or misleading appearances; effective for deception but vulnerable to a keen or powerful divine sense.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Fifth Sister die?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li activated a hidden restriction he placed in her body when he removed her Blood Curse, converting the antidote’s residual power into a lethal poison.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Was the Young Prince predicted to be absent?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No, Han Li did not anticipate the Young Prince being out. The night raid was executed on the assumption the target would be at home, but the operation failed due to simple bad luck.
